name: What permits are required for a basement ADU conversion?
description: Various permits are required, including building, electrical, and specific ADU permits. Prepare by understanding local zoning and gathering existing home plans.

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for a basement ADU conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basement ADU conversions require various permits, including building, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical permits, as well as specific ADU permits from your local jurisdiction. For instance, cities like Oakland and Emeryville have distinct ADU ordinances. A key preparation step is to gather existing plans of your home and understand local zoning codes, as these will inform the design and feasibility, helping streamline the permitting process.
